scenes.name: Disco
scenes.book: Loops 1 y 2. Una historia de la música electrónica
scenes.author: Javier Blánquez (ed.)
scenes.desc: Al subir el bombo y las líneas de bajo del funk y el soul, la música libera su componente hedonista: hacer bailar en las discotecas y elevar el voltaje erótico del sonido.

podcast.title: Featured in "Klute" Movie Scene (1971)
podcast.body: Francis Grasso was depicted DJing in a scene from the 1971 Jane Fonda movie "Klute." The scene was set in The Sanctuary, a former church that had been converted into a nightclub. "you saw a scene where Francis, DJ Francis is in the sanctuary, a church that was converted into a nightclub."

podcast.title: Club Mix for Sexual Experience
podcast.body: He created an early example of a club mix by matching the drum solo from Chicago's "I'm a Man" with Robert Plant's moaning and groaning in Led Zeppelin's "Whole Lotta Love," which resulted in a powerful, sexual experience. "he created this powerful sexual experience."

podcast.title: Inventor of Beat Matching
podcast.body: Francis Grasso is widely considered the inventor of matching beats, a technique that allowed DJs to control the entire vibe on the dance floor by ensuring continuous music flow. "many considered to be the inventor of matching beats."
